acceptanceCriteria: Digests for the admitted go1.27.2 linux/amd64 toolchain (and linux/arm64 if used) are recorded from an observed toolchain, with the observation method retained.
script/check-sql-native-ratchets.sh passes on a Linux runner.
SNR-V0-003 and its tests cover the Linux rows.
body: Follow-up of V1-2120, residual from lane PR beamfall/corvint#1433 (tools-1021c, seal head 38023a87a, base 0106d06cd). The admitted-toolchain table (SNR-V0-003 in docs/specs/sql-native-ratchet-gate-v0.md) is content-pinned for go1.27.2 official module and go1.27.3 Homebrew on darwin/arm64 only. Linux digests are NOT_OBSERVED. Expected: the ratchet passes on a Linux runner with the admitted go1.27.2 toolchain. Actual: script/check-sql-native-ratchets.sh prints TOOLCHAIN_MISMATCH and exits 78 on every Linux host.
title: SNR ratchet toolchain table has no Linux digests, so check-sql-native-ratchets.sh refuses on every Linux host
